coverage.note: 3 of 14 completed games have a parsed file, which is what a bar requires.

derivation.real: Every number here is measured. Scores and margins come from the inventory (score authority: the parsed game file); each team's success rate is game_advanced.team_advanced.plays.success_rate_down_distance from that same file.
derivation.derived: Nothing is projected. The 2025 version of this chart had to estimate the edge from season averages because no per-game rollup existed; the export now ships it, so the bar measures what happened rather than what the matchup implied.
derivation.pass_note: Success is the down-and-distance rule — half the needed yards on first down, 70% on second, all of them on third and fourth.
